Each optional peer on disk is the lowest version its range admits (rich-unfiled-791c.25dh)

Nothing tied the peer ranges to what src/ compiles against: on
rich-animation-27tq.0gd src/ imported a 0.11.0 export under a ^0.10.0 range and
only a code review saw it. With the peers held at their floors, lint is the
compile at the floor and the suite runs there too, so the gate needs no registry,
temp tree or second tsc. It reads the version on disk rather than the lockfile,
because that incident was a --no-save tarball the lockfile never saw.

Several effects run on one element at once, as one Effect (rich-unfiled-791c.75gd) (#525)

* Several effects run on one element at once, as one Effect (rich-unfiled-791c.75gd)

A frame was handed one look and read it for two facts: which of the
element's colours a cell is, and what is there now. Alone those are one
value. Folded, a second layer found no colour it knew, or took a turned
colour for another of the element's and turned it twice.

EffectCell.pair replaces terminal and reverse and carries what the element
drew, so a frame recognises a cell by its pair and moves its look. layered
folds effects over that. Each loop's proof of the contrast floor is about
colours as drawn, which another layer voids, so layered holds the floor
itself once the layers have moved a cell: the ground lands where its inks
keep room, and an ink that does not read lands on the side it stands on,
both measured as written. pulsedOn in effects-feel was this fold by hand.

Breaking: a frame reading cell.terminal or cell.reverse reads cell.pair.

* A loop with nothing it lights lets the host sleep at every depth (rich-unfiled-791c.75gd)

Step 10 review of #525. Each loop now hands the hold-still gate what it
lights, because `drawn.colors` lists word cells only and a colour named for
`onColors` under blanks has to keep moving. A translucent ink is laid on the
ground as it landed. layered's docstring no longer claims a swap draws as it
would alone, and a test pins that it lands at the floor. The side-keeping test
drops the six compositions it skipped without asserting.

* A loop sleeps when no cell it is handed shows what it lights (rich-unfiled-791c.75gd)

Step 11 review of #525. The hold-still gate tested whether the lit set was
empty, so a named colour no cell draws, a confined effect with no owner in the
frame, and a name matching only the terminal's ink all woke the host for
nothing. It now reads the cells it is handed, which confined has narrowed, and
hands the loop the set it read so gradient resolves its names once. The docs
say a painter covers what is beneath it. ruleFrame listed cells in a pair its
`colors` did not name, which no real Drawn can do.

* The sleep gate reads the sides a loop moves and the cells that show (rich-unfiled-791c.75gd)

Step 12 review of #525. A moving gradient whose colour lay only on a ground, or
under a blank that shows nothing, still woke the host, since the gate read both
sides of every listed cell. Each loop now names its sides, and the gate reads
`cells`. `confined` holds its narrowed lists for the frame, as `measured` does,
so the gate adds no second filter. Two comments that described the listing and
a still loop are brought up to it.
